verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor. User-configurable background automations are an application or OS feature, not a capability a CPU/APU ships, so this axis does not apply to this kind of product. The evidence pack mentions GAIA, an open-source framework for building local AI agents, but it is a developer building block. Nothing in the pack shows the product itself offering autonomous or scheduled background automations, so the exception for shipped capabilities does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
